spec: messaging section 4 + section 19 amendment A11; identity section 6.5 - CounterStore::observe_counter: the 32-entry window as a fresh/stale verdict, never a rejection
description: Each sequence runs against ONE fresh CounterStore and ONE peer (any NodeId). observe_counter offers the counter to the identity section 6.5 window exactly as on_receive does: a counter above high-water slides the window (shift >= 32 resets the bitmap to 1); a counter inside the window whose bit is clear sets it; either is 'fresh' and the state advances. A counter already seen, or 32 or more behind high-water, is 'stale': Ok(Stale), NO state change (on_receive would return Err(Window) for exactly these). 'high' (decimal string) and 'bitmap' (bit i = counter high - i seen) are the window AFTER the step. A11: replay authority for msg_seq kinds is Layer 5's own state; the verdict gates connection attribution, card answers and proactive pushes only.
provenance: Generated 2026-10-14 (task L5-I1) from an independent Python model of the identity section 6.5 window; asserted against id111::counters::CounterStore (observe_counter verdict + window, and on_receive parity on a twin store) by tests/layer5_amendments.rs; re-derived by crosscheck.py (check_layer5_counters).
